reason: The hypothesis directly restates the core idea from P7 and P27 that local chemical order (LCO/SRO) roughens dislocation pathways and governs strength, applying it to the specific Cr-Mn-Fe-Co-Ni subset system without combining findings from multiple papers or introducing a new mechanism. The proposal to vary elemental subsets to modulate SRO is the same concept as tuning LCO via processing or composition already discussed in P7.
